name: cpp-style-enforcer-codex
description: C++ code style enforcement for Codex with tracked-file encoding preservation and staged-content commit checks.

interface.shortDescription: Enforce team C++ style automatically in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Checks and repairs C++ edits automatically, delivering remaining issues to Codex as internal repair instructions without chat warnings or Stop continuation messages. Enforces project line endings while preserving byte encoding. Commit-time cpplint checks staged Git content without modifying the working tree or index.
defaultPrompt: Configure C++ style enforcement for this project.
